photoSet.workAssociationEvidence: Four member-named introduction CONCEPT PHOTO #1 portraits were published in November 2024. They are used as a consistent clear-face recognition reference for REALLY REALLY, whose debut release came later; not asserted as MV stills or same MV-era photographs. These replace the rejected School Rush distant/underlit candidate set without changing the existing work-member tuples.

qualityNotes: Original source bytes and native dimensions preserved. Actual 3:4 source crop reviewed with clear facial features and natural expression; no generated details or upscaling.
Recognition reference, not a claim that the image depicts the bound MV scene.

KOO HANNA lightly rests fingertips below the lower lip; mouth remains visible. All four keep full heads and readable facial detail in actual native 3:4 crops. Original portrait bytes preserved, not brightened or enlarged.

selectionReview.reason: Closer, well-lit gray introduction concept series selected after School Rush full-body RISAKO was rejected for small dark face. All selected images show both eyes, nose and mouth clearly; no flower/hand over an eye.
